content: {"episode_id":"ep-05024","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"Claim for Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was denied under Reason Code CO-197 for precertification or prior authorization not obtained before services were rendered. The clinical indication note documents that the patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness (R42) in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries (I25.10) and nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0). Per the note, mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes that may be contributing to these symptomatic episodes."}
